display: Personified Upanishads as a circle of women

depiction_rules.notes: For D100 stanza 1 only, show a small group of distinct adult women as personifications of the Upanishads surrounding the youthful divine form. Keep them fully clothed and quietly devotional; do not add readable scroll text or symbols that resemble letters.

visual_bible.faces: Distinct calm faces with varied hair and modest ornaments; no cloned faces.
visual_bible.body: Natural adult proportions, each with two attached arms and hands.
visual_bible.clothing: Opaque cream, muted maroon and ochre drapes, kept modest and consistent with the matte mural palette.
visual_bible.composition: A compact supporting group that does not obscure the deity, Narada or Bhattathiri.

never: no readable text, manuscript writing or watermarks
no glossy skin or metallic ornament
